actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-247.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans and other eligible individuals requesting secure firearm storage items from the VA.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall carry out a program to provide to an eligible individual, upon the request of the eligible individual--a covered item or a redeemable voucher

dimensions.assessment: Provides firearm lockboxes and educational information to interested individuals without altering underlying firearm ownership rights.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this Act or the amendments made by this Act may be construed... to require mandatory firearm storage for any such individual

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2036.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2036

dimensions.assessment: Directs the VA to establish a permanent distribution program, public education campaign, informational video, and annual Congressional reports.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than October 1, 2025, and not less frequently than annually thereafter, the Secretary shall submit to the appropriate committees of Congress a report

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes program funding and reporting requirements spanning an 11-year period from fiscal years 2026 through 2036.
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2036

missing_information: Exact number of eligible veterans who will request or receive lockboxes
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes appropriations of $5,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026 through 2036 for the Department of Veterans Affairs to provide firearm lockboxes, educational materials, and a public education campaign to eligible individuals as a suicide prevention strategy.
